'''VibroSword Eight''' was the callsign of the eighth member of [[VibroSword Squadron]], which flew for the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] during [[Operation Roundabout]]. During said battle, a [[Unidentified pilot (VibroSword Eight)|pilot]] flew under the sign.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal" />
